description: Crawl a live website (up to 20 same-origin pages) and build a Content-Security-Policy for it. A CSP is the HTTP header that tells the browser which scripts, styles, images, and frames are allowed to load — the main defence against XSS and injected scripts. strict.description: Generate a stricter policy (fewer broad allowances)

url.description: The public website URL to crawl, e.g. https://example.com
